resources.string: Fares are what riders paid, before the platform’s commission. Distance and duration appear only when the report has them; Bolt invoices don’t.
Import Bolt’s rider invoices (CSV) and your trips appear here. Files stay on this phone.
A dash means this report doesn’t include it.
Rider details are removed during import: no name, phone number or address is stored.
Fees are known only for days imported from a report.
Trips, paid km, hours online and what you make per hour and per km appear here once a report includes them: Bolt invoices and monthly summary, or Uber reports.
Tap a bar to see a day
Trip fares by weekday and time of day: when you drove and earned, not pay per hour. The top slot is outlined; tap a cell for its total.
Bar chart, one bar per day. Use actions to move between days.
Bar chart, one bar per month. Use actions to move between months.
Typed in or estimated: days without a breakdown screenshot.
In the app and cash are before commission. Paid to your account = earned minus cash in hand.

Estimated from Bolt’s monthly total or trips, because this day has no screenshot. A screenshot of the day replaces it; if you save your own amount, it stays as you set it.
Used for hours online and how much you make per hour. A newer screenshot of the same period replaces this one.
Used for fuel costs and what you make per km. You can add or change it later under Vehicle.
Ridely doesn’t use this file, so it isn’t read. From Uber you only need payments_order, payments_organization, trip_activity and driver_time_and_distance.
Your income for each day, after Uber’s fee. Each day replaces what Uber had on that day in the app.
Uber’s fee isn’t in this file: add payments_organization for it.
Each trip’s earnings come from the payments file (payments_order).
Uber’s totals for the period: what the money is made of and Uber’s fee. Not added as income.
Used for hours online and how much you make per hour. The km are kept for working out fuel later.
On supplier.uber.com → Reports, choose the month and download the payments report: its file name contains payments_order. It has each day’s income, bonuses and cash.
The file whose name contains trip_activity. The addresses in it are not saved.

Once a week, Ridely saves a backup over one file you choose. Pick Google Drive, and a lost or new phone won’t lose your data: install Ridely, then Your data → Restore from backup and choose that file.
The last backup couldn’t be saved. The file may have been moved or deleted: choose it again.
Android’s own backup also keeps Ridely’s data in your Google account when Backup is on in the phone’s settings, and brings it back when you set up a new phone.
